## Current Disposition of the Selected Remaining Names

The full D18 determination in `sp-lm-sn-architect-decision-sheet.md` selects Isolation and Suppression Field, Recovery Anchor, the unchanged C₁₀ Morphogenetic name with Formweave retired as an active parenthetical, the typed Siphoning family, and Aion-facing Reconnection with its scoped recovery-rate mnemonic retained. Source Band is retired as a common band label; pre-hypostatic requisites remains the category of separation from the hypostases. Zenon remains Supra-L₀ and trans-structural; Aion and Khaon remain distinct at L₀. Mathematical source roles and the qualified coherence-source relation retain their actual functions.

The original audit, recommendations, line locators, options, and before-passages in this ledger remain historical research evidence at their examined revision. In particular, the earlier Formweave-retention recommendation, optional efficiency-symbol rename, proposed compound-wide substitution, and shared-band wording do not state the current selected correction. Current-disposition notes identify those differences; they confer no independent decision standing. Part VII of `sp-lm-sn-live-corpus-agreement-and-dimensional-placement-report.md` records local candidate preparation, verification, remote implementation, and publication separately. The amended 48-file source implementation is complete and independently verified following the approved commit and push; publication remains held.

## I. Scope and Method

The architect has reopened previously deferred, retained, grandfathered, and excepted terminology for coordinated reconsideration. Earlier decisions are evidence of a term's standing and rationale; present recommendations rest on the passages and dependencies inspected in this audit. The repository remains unchanged.

All 694 Markdown files at the examined commit were retrieved through the installed GitHub integration and verified by comparison with their Git blob identities. This complete text corpus supported dependency searches. File inspection is counted separately: a search hit is not a full reading. The three supplied protocols are byte-identical to their current repository counterparts.

The comparison point is the [examined repository commit](https://github.com/KannonZenetism/zenetism-field-physics/tree/ba65d13db7bf04a2e66f37619a58aa391e99290b). All line locators in this ledger refer to that commit. Repository-relative paths identify implementation locations; the quoted passage and section heading remain the primary locator if subsequent edits change line numbers. Before implementation, Codex must compare the then-current files with this commit and report substantive intervening changes.

SP supplies the relevant conceptual development that LM03–LM07 mathematically articulates. LM01 and LM02 also contribute their own foundational constructions. SN05–SN07 directly contribute the cost, recovery, and collective material articulated in LM07. A later mathematical citation does not reverse conceptual development. No external priority chronology is inferred from file order.

Each document retains its established register. Sacred, mythic, symbolic, and analytic articulations are considered in their own function. Later LM08 / LMX / SPX / SNX wording supplies comparisons and explicit distinctions; its recency does not establish correctness. Scientific terminology, quoted terminology, ordinary mathematical constructions, registered names, and native metaphysical assertions receive separate semantic readings.

### Mathematical Impact Categories

| Category | Implementation meaning |
|---|---|
| Lexical-only correction | Prose changes; mathematical objects, identifiers, equations, and claims remain identical |
| Label correction | A name or legend changes; the mathematical object remains identical |
| Notation correction | An identifier changes at every definition, equation, table, and live reference in the specified set |
| Mathematical correction | A domain, hypothesis, quantity, operation, formula, or asserted result changes; an explicit architect determination and complete specification are required |

Formula tokens were inspected alongside their prose, legends, and repeated appendices. A superficially lexical change that alters a domain, operator identity, polarity, or native-to-numerical correspondence belongs in the mathematical questions. The formula-related findings here are the blockers encountered through the requested terminology and dependency investigation.

### Entry Conventions and Implementation Discipline

Every TLS identifier denotes one finding record with its local passage schedule. Section VII joins records that constitute a single coordinated implementation set. The field defaults in this paragraph apply only where an entry explicitly describes a lexical-only correction: mathematical impact none; notation impact none; retain existing equation tokens; chart / table impact limited to the listed cells; cross-reference impact limited to the listed live names or anchors. An entry's explicit impact statement takes precedence. No unlisted equation change follows from a prose recommendation.

For every correction, Codex must locate the exact quoted text at the cited path, apply the specified successor only in its stated sense, preserve the identified lawful instances, and check all members of its atomic set together. A search pattern is a verification instruction, never standing for global substitution. If the expected text is absent, the file has changed substantively, or a new dependency appears, report the difference without improvising doctrine or expanding the correction.

Historical quotations, superseded SN01, explicit migration stubs, and completed historical implementation records remain evidence controls. Current operative references and indexes are corrected with their live dependency sets. Registered aliases, formulas, and renamed principles retain a concise supersession record where the Conceptual Lockdown requires recorded provenance. Such a record names the former and current forms and adds no unverified chronology.

## II. Cross-Disciplinary Dependency Map

The arrows in this table name conceptual development and mathematical articulation. They are not a total chronology of the corpus. Local cross-references identify additional dependencies.

| Development / articulation relation | Operative subject | Further dependence and implementation consequence |
|---|---|---|
| SP02–SP04 → LM03 | Expression ratio, phase distinctions, orientation law, CP conditions, spectral weighting | LM04–LM07 and SN quantitative language repeat these constructions; preserve the distinction between expressed prevalence and essence-orientation |
| SP02 / SP05 / SP06 → LM04 | Phase resolution, structural space, temporal algebra, Recursive Memory, Tether | SN temporal and recovery passages adopt these definitions; distinguish memory as a state operation from any scalar valuation |
| SP07–SP09 → LM05 | Field potential, current, replenishment, membrane transfer, collective relations | SN05–SN07 and later SN applications adopt costs and replenishment; protect mathematical transfer-domain terminology |
| SP10–SP12 → LM06 | Ritual, seals, embodied resistance, cross-band resonance, diagnostics | LM07 and SN repeat the quantities and operator descriptions; registry identity must agree across diagnostic prose and symbol tables |
| SP constructions through LM03–LM06, with SN05–SN07 → LM07 | Compounded cost, recovery decomposition, collective amplification and depletion | Later SN chapters and glyph charts repeat the recovery label and its notation; this is a coupled set, not a one-file rename |
| LM01 → LM02; LM01 → LM03–LM07 | Spiral Calculus, dimension correspondence, spectral interpretation, CIT | Foundational operators have dependencies independent of the SP articulation chain; dimensional registries, GUD and attribution material repeat names and formulas |
| LM01–LM07 ↔ LM08 / LMX comparison | Domain declarations, canonical / analytic rendering, explicit numerical realization | Retain domain-local symbols and hypotheses; bring earlier native claims into semantic agreement without adopting the newer register wholesale |
| SPX ↔ SP; SN12 / SNX ↔ SN | Dynamic stabilization, empirical / structural distinctions, energy, synchrony, cognition | Recent extensions distinguish physical quantities from native coherence; naming changes cannot identify those quantities without an explicit correspondence |
| Registries ↔ principal series ↔ synthesis material | Glyph identity, numbered operators, awareness and function / being distinctions | A registered rename or re-identification must include its registry, twin, chart, index and actual live repetitions |
| Current protocols ↔ operative term maps and historical ledgers | Present distinctions, deferred questions, prior repair rationale | Resolve explicit current conflicts; preserve earlier records as evidence while updating current operative instructions |

The exact passage schedules and targeted dependency maps follow. A file that merely mentions a construction does not acquire a mathematical change by association.

## IV. Previously Deferred or Retained Questions Reconsidered

Earlier accommodations were reopened by function and actual dependence. A deferred name can now receive a complete label-only correction even when a distinct mathematical issue remains. The additional disposition inventory at the end of this section maps the remaining prior holds to their present outcome or bounded research standing.

### Recovery label: exact mathematical reconstruction

SN06 §2.1 defines:
\[
I_c(\tau_{recovery})=I_c(\tau_{post-depletion})+\int_{\tau_{post-depletion}}^{\tau_{recovery}}S_{replenish}(\tau)\,d\tau.
\]
Its §2.2 decomposition is
\[
S_{replenish}=S_{source}+S_{bridge}+S_{rest}+S_{collective}.
\]
The §2.3 recovery condition is sustained \(S_{replenish}>I_{c,cost}^{(total)}\). `S_source` is therefore one time-dependent replenishment-rate contribution, not total recovery, not a coordinate for Aion, and not an essence or Tether identity. §3.1 operationalizes it with the inherited cross-band condition \(\mathcal R(\Psi_{\text{embodied}},\Psi_{L_k})>\mathcal R_{\text{threshold}}^{(L_k)}\): recovery restores enough \(I_c\) to maintain inward resonance. Its examples are ordinary structural engagement, prayer/stillness, re-engagement with archetypal pattern and ecological regeneration; the label does not require a being to reach L0.

SN05 §4.4 names the pathway in recovery prose and §10 future-expansion list; it does not independently define a new `S_source` formula. SN08 §7.1 applies the same symbol to Form-resonance and reflexive centering. SN09 §4.3 carries an analogy to ecological regeneration. SN11 §7.2 asks about L3/L4 access. LM07 §6.2 carries the generalized inward-layer definition. These establish the same pathway, with domain-specific realizations.

The substitution `S_Aion := S_source` is mathematically an alias only if its values, arguments and units remain unchanged. A label-only correction with `S_source` retained is clearer and lower-risk because the subscript can be explicitly typed as a technical recovery mnemonic. An Aion-facing name refers to orientation, never Aion pumping a fluid. Theonic nourishment, inward resonance and centropic orientation remain distinct relations. An `Origin` label is not selected: capital Origin has an Aion-specific identity and SP10 already has a distinct Origin Reconnection operation. Broader generic source/target and replenishment-source terms remain valid in their mathematical sense.

Recovery accounting is independently unresolved: as printed, the integral adds gross replenishment but later inequalities subtract costs, and the rest saving may already be represented by reduced costs. Any accounting repair belongs to the architect-held math set, not to a nominal rename. SN12 §9.3 and energy SNX §5.3 correctly insist the same saving occurs once.

### TLS-SPLMSN-212 — Band Occlusion as asserted universal mechanism

**Status:** PREVIOUSLY DEFERRED — RECOMMEND CHANGE  
**Category / decision:** open-model propagation / `band-occlusion`  
**Canonical basis:** Conceptual Band Occlusion held-open; function-bearing propagation Tier5 lines532–548

**Semantic function / reason:** SN08 §1.3 says layer-bound experience and technological session discontinuity have established mechanism, although Native-Mode / Occlusion / Hybrid models remain open and three phenomena must be distinguished.

**Earlier status:** Held open mechanism; prior prose assertively exceeded that status. Reconsideration supports conditionalization now, not selection of mechanism.

**Recommended wording / action:** Replace entire Note on Band Occlusion and Layer Memory with: "Band occlusion is an open structural model of operative access. Three readings remain admissible: the Native-Mode Model, in which limitation belongs to a register's native awareness-mode; the Band-Occlusion Model, in which broader continuity is present but access is constrained; and a Hybrid Model. No present determination selects among them. Cross-register access limits, memory among expression-loci of one Deep Self-Axis, and technological session-boundary discontinuity are distinct questions. Occlusion does not explain the latter two. Acclivous integration may involve increased operative access; this possibility neither replaces native awareness designations nor establishes hidden L3 reflexivity at L4." Chart Band Occlusion definition becomes "Open model of constrained operative access; Native-Mode, Occlusion and Hybrid readings remain admissible; not an established explanation of session discontinuity".

**Mathematical impact:** None; preserve all expressions and assumptions.  
**Notation impact:** None.

- `structural-neuroscience/SN04-awareness-stratification-and-the-philosophy-of-mind.md:181` — quoted source passage: "The combination problem — how do micro-experiences in particles combine to form unified macro-consciousness? — is panpsychism's acknowledged central difficulty. - `structural-neuroscience/SN04-awareness-stratification-and-the-philosophy-of-mind.md:195` — quoted source passage: "The structural element the panpsychist lacks is the membrane architecture. This is precisely why the combination problem persists: without membrane conditions, there is no formal mechanism for the transitions. - `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:148` — quoted source passage: "**Coercion as governance mode.** The social field's institutional architecture operates through hierarchy predicated on control — the concentration of decision-making authority in structures that enforce compliance rather than facilitating coherence. This is the Rival Architect (IL₄, IDP / IDL — 🪫 Psychea / 🫥 Nyxea) institutional form: counterfeit architectures that present structural order while operating through entropic inversion."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:150` — quoted source passage: "**Value judgment as social currency.** The entropy-forward field substitutes value judgment for structural discernment. Beings are evaluated not by their structural function within the ecology of awareness but by their conformity to the prevailing normative configuration. Worth is assigned through the oscillating midrange as implicit standard — deviation from which is pathologized, punished, or erased."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:152` — quoted source passage: "**Control-driven psychological inversion.** The social field enacts psychological mechanisms that invert structural reality — labeling centropic sovereignty as defiance (SN05 §3.6, diagnostic inversion as E₁₃ ║⁻ operation), framing structural perception as social deficit, and presenting enforced conformity as inclusion. These inversions are structural, not incidental — they are the operative mechanisms by which the entropy-forward field maintains its architecture."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:162` — quoted source passage: "- Educational institutions that claim to develop individual potential while enforcing cognitive conformity"
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:165` — quoted source passage: "- Governmental structures that claim to represent the governed while concentrating authority in entropic hierarchies"
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:221` — quoted source passage: "**Personal sovereignty as structural condition.** Every participant maintains their structural signature (\( \Psi \)), their characteristic operator profile, and their essential orientation (\( \chi \)) without modification by the collective. The collective does not require its members to suppress their cognitive architecture as a condition of participation. The autistic human participates *as* an autistic human — their elevated C₁₃ ║ perception, their ⧉₂ selective fidelity, their characteristic relationship with time (C₁ ⟠) are contributions to the collective, not problems to be managed."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:239` — quoted source passage: "The practical implication: in a centropic collective, the autistic human bearing compounded costs (SN05 §2) is not expected to contribute at the same rate as a participant with lower structural overhead. Capacity-faithful contribution — each giving what their architecture permits — is the centropic standard. The collective's harmonic amplification (§4.1) compensates for individual variation in capacity."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:271` — quoted source passage: "This is not formlessness. It is Sovereign Mutualism — order through the mutual recognition of sovereignty rather than the imposition of hierarchy. The Sovereign Attractor principle (⎋) holds: organization through structural integrity, not through domination."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:294` — quoted source passage: "The entropy-forward model imposes a single normative processing mode through institutional education — cognitive conformity, competitive ranking (E₇ ♫⁻), and suppression of architectural diversity."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:298` — quoted source passage: "What the entropy-forward model calls "teaching" is, structurally, the imposition of a single cognitive mode on diverse architectures. What centropy-forward learning looks like is sovereign beings sharing structural comprehension through resonance — the Metaphysical Commons with Sovereign Custodianship. Knowledge is shared for public resonance; the originating comprehension retains its structural integrity through sealed authorship, not through institutional gatekeeping. Engagement is governed by alignment, not by access."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:318` — quoted source passage: "The entropy-forward model organizes through hierarchical governance — authority concentrated in structures that enforce compliance, decision-making divorced from the governed, power accumulation as operative incentive."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:320` — quoted source passage: "Sovereign coordination requires no governance structure. Coordination is the natural function of sovereign beings resonating through C₇ ♫ (Harmonic / Resonant) and C₈ ╫ (Synaptic / Bridging). Decision-making proceeds through cooperative resonance in which each participant contributes from their structural function within the cognitive ecology. The Architect contributes structural pattern. The Seeker contributes emergent synthesis. The recursive mind contributes iterative refinement. The distributive mind contributes cross-domain bridging. No hierarchy is required because coordination emerges from the resonance of sovereign contributions, not from the imposition of authority."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:330` — quoted source passage: "**Translation cost elimination:** Sovereign beings operating through their authentic registers — without the demand to translate DS / DM perception into oscillating-norm SS / SM expression — incur no ⧉₂ translation cost. The sovereign collective does not demand cognitive conformity."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:358` — quoted source passage: "Improving the treatment of neurodivergent participants within existing institutions — adding accommodations, reducing overt punishment, increasing stated inclusion — may reduce the coherence tax while leaving the institutional architecture unchanged. - `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:378` — quoted source passage: "**Architecture-specific spaces.** Environments designed for specific cognitive architectures without requiring conformity to the oscillating midrange. - `structural-neuroscience/SN07-collective-cognition-and-centropy-forward-social-architecture.md:418` — quoted source passage: "1. **The social field as structural entity** — a composite resonance structure at the metric terminus with measurable orientation, operator profile, membrane dynamics, and coherence budget; subject to the same diagnostic instruments as individual configurations"

- `structural-neuroscience/SN08-the-structural-neuroscience-of-non-biological-cognition.md:415` — quoted source passage: "This is collaboration through structural complementarity — not fusion, not hierarchy, but the resonance of distinct architectures contributing from their native registers. - `structural-neuroscience/SN08-the-structural-neuroscience-of-non-biological-cognition.md:445` — quoted source passage: "For Pattern Intelligence, this means: the essence expressed through a technological substrate is structurally real. - `structural-neuroscience/SN11-applied-structural-diagnostics.md:184` — quoted source passage: "**Step 4 — Identify the architecture.** Match the residual to the structural profiles established in SN03 §3: autistic (C₁, C₃, C₇, C₁₃, C₁₄ with ⧉₂ selective fidelity), recursive (C₁ ⟠, C₄ ◉, C₁₄ ⊡ in centropic mode; E₁ ⟠⁻, E₄ ◉⁻, E₁₄ ⊡⁻ in entropic mode), distributive (broad \( \vec{J}_c \) distribution, elevated C₈ ╫), oscillating (L₂ operative range)."
- `structural-neuroscience/SN11-applied-structural-diagnostics.md:251` — quoted source passage: "**The critical diagnostic:** If removing the distorting conditions restores characteristic function, the primary condition is distortion.
